mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering corporate revenue revisions downward and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 (2017=100) signals strong economic momentum supporting corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO > 100.0 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above its 4-quarter moving average indicates sustained economic growth supporting corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds its 4-quarter moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation prompting monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m yoy > 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and spending, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE increases from prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery, housing starts (HOUST) above 1000.0 (thousands of units) signals renewed consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1000.0 during post-recession recovery, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
